writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the hypnosis guide and community lanes' writer

findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
examples: What review or appeal can you safely give them?
findings.reason: The linter sees the question alone; in the article it is one question in a list of questions in the middle of its paragraph, not its end.

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is his own line (SOURCE.txt) put back in place of Emulate's wording, so it follows his order by design; the paragraph around it keeps its own order and asides.

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The guide speaks to the reader as "you" throughout; this sentence uses it to give one step, inside a paragraph that is not a run of coaching lines.
